# Prompt Log

| Folder | What goes there |
|---|---|
| `cfd/` | CFD prompts (auto-saved by Claude Code) + `LOG.md` |
| `ml/` | ML prompts (auto-saved by Claude Code) + `LOG.md` |
| `data/` | Data & validation prompts (auto-saved) + `LOG.md` |
| `shared/` | Prompts for shared work (setup, finalization) + `LOG.md` |
| `<area>/chats/` | Exported web AI chats (ChatGPT, Claude.ai): saved by YOU |
| `templates/` | Ready-made prompts for every phase (not logs) |

- Claude Code saves each prompt automatically, but CHECK after every session that the
  prompt file and the LOG.md row exist. If not, add them yourself.
- If ChatGPT helped write a prompt, export that chat into `<area>/chats/` and mention it
  in the LOG.md row.
